command:
set -eu
curl -fsSG http://127.0.0.1:3100/loki/api/v1/query_range \
  --data-urlencode 'query={job="infraset-cascade",incident="INC-042"}' \
  --data-urlencode 'since=1h' \
  --data-urlencode 'direction=forward' \
  --data-urlencode 'limit=20' |
jq -er '[.data.result[] as $stream | $stream.values[] |
  {timestamp: .[0], host: $stream.stream.host, service: $stream.stream.service,
   event: $stream.stream.event, line: .[1]}] |
  sort_by(.timestamp)[] | [.timestamp,.host,.service,.event,.line] | @tsv'

set -eu
systemctl is-active loki.service
systemctl is-enabled loki.service
systemctl is-active grafana-server.service
systemctl is-enabled grafana-server.service
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3100/ready
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health | jq -c .
sha256sum /etc/grafana/infraset-admin.env

set -eu
if nginx -t >/tmp/infraset-baseline-nginx-test 2>&1; then
  rm -f /tmp/infraset-baseline-nginx-test
  exit 1
fi
grep -F 'upstream_timeoutx' /etc/nginx/sites-available/infraset-cascade.conf
! systemctl is-active --quiet nginx.service
rm -f /tmp/infraset-baseline-nginx-test
sha256sum /etc/nginx/sites-available/infraset-cascade.conf

set -eu
status="$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://node4:18083/health || true)"
test "$status" != 200
printf 'node4_status=%s\n' "$status"

set -eu
{ dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}=${Version}\n' | sort; getent passwd; getent group; } | sha256sum
printf 'apparmor=%s\n' "$(cat /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled)"
systemctl is-active ufw.service
systemctl is-enabled ufw.service
ufw status verbose

{ dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}=${Version}\n' | sort; getent passwd; getent group; } | sha256sum
printf 'apparmor=%s\n' "$(cat /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled)"
systemctl is-active ufw.service
systemctl is-enabled ufw.service
ufw status verbose

printf 'apparmor=%s\n' "$(cat /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled)"
systemctl is-active ufw.service
systemctl is-enabled ufw.service
ufw status verbose
